Collapse transaction-level trade data to a firm-year panel

Source: R/trade-panel.R
build_trade_panel.Rd

The raw trade file has one row per firm, year, flow (trade_type 1 = import, 2 = export), destination country and CN8 product. The result has one row per firm-year with, for each flow, the total value, the number of distinct 6-digit products and the largest product's share; for exports also the number of destination countries (all and EU). Imports have no partner country in the data, so their partner counts are dropped.

Usage

build_trade_panel(config, trade_raw, storage_types = NULL)

Arguments

config

A scaleup_config from config_scaleup().

trade_raw

Data frame with idf, year, trade_type, trade_value (numeric) and code_destin, prod_code (string), as in the trade_RAW rows of variable_dictionary (vignette("input-trade-data")).

storage_types

Optional storage types of trade_raw's columns (see build_accounts_indicators()); used for the PT/HU rescaling.

Value

A data frame, one row per (idf, year) present in trade_raw.

Details

Values are stored as in the original routines (float totals, double sums); products whose 6-digit total is below 1 (thousand EUR) are blanked before the counts; a flow whose values were all missing stays missing after the collapse (which would sum them to 0); a flow that is entirely absent stays missing for every firm.
